## Data Staleness Monitor

This section checks the last available date for every Haver series used across the project's PCE, PPI, and CPI code. Series whose end date matches the most recent available month are highlighted in green; those between the most recent and the 3-month stale cutoff are in yellow; and those past the cutoff (or missing entirely) are in red.

```{r staleness-monitor}
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Define all Haver series used across the project, grouped by source
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
series_registry <- tribble(
  ~series_code,   ~database,   ~source_group, ~description,
  
  # --- PCE Nominal Expenditures (USNA) ---
  "cm",           "USNA",      "PCE",         "Overall PCE NE",
  "cxfem",        "USNA",      "PCE",         "Core PCE NE",
  "cgxfem",       "USNA",      "PCE",         "Goods ex F&E NE",
  "csm",          "USNA",      "PCE",         "Services NE",
  "csxhem",       "USNA",      "PCE",         "Services ex E&HC NE",
  "csdm",         "USNA",      "PCE",         "HC Services NE",
  "csdom",        "USNA",      "PCE",         "Outpatient Services NE",
  "csmpm",        "USNA",      "PCE",         "Physician Services NE",
  "csmdm",        "USNA",      "PCE",         "Dental Services NE",
  "csmom",        "USNA",      "PCE",         "Paramedical Services NE",
  "csmnm",        "USNA",      "PCE",         "Home & Nursing NE",
  "csmhpm",       "USNA",      "PCE",         "Hospital Services NE",
  "csmhnm",       "USNA",      "PCE",         "Nursing Homes NE",
  "ctgm",         "USNA",      "PCE",         "Total Goods NE",
  
  # --- PCE Price Indices (USNA) ---
  "jcm",          "USNA",      "PCE",         "Overall PCE PI",
  "jcxfem",       "USNA",      "PCE",         "Core PCE PI",
  "jcgxfem",      "USNA",      "PCE",         "Goods ex F&E PI",
  "jcsm",         "USNA",      "PCE",         "Services PI",
  "jcsxhem",      "USNA",      "PCE",         "Services ex E&HC PI",
  "jcsdm",        "USNA",      "PCE",         "HC Services PI",
  "jcsdom",       "USNA",      "PCE",         "Outpatient Services PI",
  "jcsmpm",       "USNA",      "PCE",         "Physician Services PI",
  "jcsmdm",       "USNA",      "PCE",         "Dental Services PI",
  "jcsmom",       "USNA",      "PCE",         "Paramedical Services PI",
  "jcsmnm",       "USNA",      "PCE",         "Home & Nursing PI",
  "jcsmhpm",      "USNA",      "PCE",         "Hospital Services PI",
  "jcsmhnm",      "USNA",      "PCE",         "Nursing Homes PI",
  "jctgm",        "USNA",      "PCE",         "Total Goods PI",
  
  # --- Core PCE (USECON) ---
  "jcxfebm",      "USECON",    "PCE",         "Core PCE PI (USECON)",
  
  # --- PPI Industry-Based (PPIR) ---
  "r6211",        "PPIR",      "PPI",         "PPI Offices of Physicians",
  "r6215",        "PPIR",      "PPI",         "PPI Medical Labs",
  "r6216",        "PPIR",      "PPI",         "PPI Home Health",
  "r622",         "PPIR",      "PPI",         "PPI Hospitals",
  "r6231",        "PPIR",      "PPI",         "PPI Nursing Facilities",
  "R62211A2",     "PPIR",      "PPI",         "PPI Hospitals - Medicare",
  "R62211A4",     "PPIR",      "PPI",         "PPI Hospitals - Medicaid",
  "R62211A6",     "PPIR",      "PPI",         "PPI Hospitals - Private/Other",
  
  # --- PPI Commodity-Based (PPI) ---
  "P512101B",     "PPI",       "PPI",         "PPI Hospital Inpatient (Commodity)",
  "P512101C",     "PPI",       "PPI",         "PPI Hospital Inpatient Medicare (Commodity)",
  "P512101D",     "PPI",       "PPI",         "PPI Hospital Inpatient Medicaid (Commodity)",
  "P511104B",     "PPI",       "PPI",         "PPI Hospital Outpatient (Commodity)",
  "P511104C",     "PPI",       "PPI",         "PPI Hospital Outpatient Medicare (Commodity)",
  "P511104D",     "PPI",       "PPI",         "PPI Hospital Outpatient Medicaid (Commodity)",
  
  # --- CPI (CPIDATA) ---
  "umsptn",       "CPIDATA",   "CPI",         "CPI Medical Care Services (NSA)",
  "umspsn",       "CPIDATA",   "CPI",         "CPI Hospital Services (NSA)"
)

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Pull each series and extract the last non-NA date
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
get_end_date <- function(code, db) {
  full_code <- paste0(code, "@", db)
  tryCatch({
    d <- import_haver(series = full_code, eop = FALSE) |>
      na.omit()
    col <- setdiff(names(d), "date")
    d <- d |> filter(!is.na(.data[[col[1]]]))
    if (nrow(d) == 0) return(as.Date(NA))
    max(d$date)
  }, error = function(e) as.Date(NA))
}

staleness <- series_registry |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(end_date = get_end_date(series_code, database)) |>
  ungroup()

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Determine the most recent end date and flag stale series
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
most_recent <- max(staleness$end_date, na.rm = TRUE)
stale_threshold <- most_recent %m-% months(3)

staleness <- staleness |>
  mutate(
    status = case_when(
      is.na(end_date)            ~ "Missing",
      end_date == most_recent    ~ "Current",
      end_date > stale_threshold ~ "Behind",
      TRUE                       ~ "Stale"
    )
  )

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Single color-coded table for all series
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
staleness_display <- staleness |>
  select(source_group, series_code, database, description, end_date, status) |>
  arrange(status, source_group, series_code)

DT::datatable(
  staleness_display,
  caption = paste0(
    "Series Staleness Monitor (most recent: ",
    format(most_recent, "%B %Y"),
    " | stale cutoff: ",
    format(stale_threshold, "%B %Y"), ")"
  ),
  colnames = c("Source", "Code", "Database", "Description", "End Date", "Status"),
  rownames = FALSE,
  extensions = 'Buttons',
  options = list(
    dom = 'Blfrtip',
    buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel'),
    pageLength = -1,
    lengthMenu = list(c(10, 25, 50, -1), c('10', '25', '50', 'All'))
  )
) |>
  DT::formatStyle(
    "status",
    target = "row",
    backgroundColor = DT::styleEqual(
      c("Current", "Behind", "Stale", "Missing"),
      c("#d4edda", "#fff3cd", "#f8d7da", "#f8d7da")
    )
  )
```
